faqs.question: What does it cost to rent an ice cream bike in Hanover?
faqs.answer: The prices for an ice cream bike vary depending on the rental period and the desired amount of ice cream. The basic price usually includes delivery in the Hanover region, collection, and professional final cleaning. For an exact, tailor-made offer, we recommend a short inquiry with the estimated number of guests.

faqs.question: Can the ice cream bike also be used indoors or in offices?
faqs.answer: Yes, that is actually one of the biggest advantages of our ice cream bike! Since it produces absolutely no exhaust fumes and easily fits through standard double doors, it can be set up without problems in lobbies, conference rooms, or on the office floor. This way, you bring the sweet refreshment directly to your colleagues' desks.

faqs.question: Which events are best suited for an ice cream bike?
faqs.answer: An ice cream bike is extremely flexible and fits wonderfully with romantic weddings, relaxed summer parties, or milestone birthdays. It is also very popular for business openings or as a charming eye-catcher in pedestrian zones. Its retro charm immediately creates a relaxed, cheerful atmosphere.

faqs.question: How much lead time is needed to reserve the ice cream bike?
faqs.answer: Especially in the hot summer months, our ice cream bikes in Hanover are very popular. We therefore recommend an early lead time of at least four to eight weeks. Spontaneous inquiries are of course possible at any time, but then depend heavily on our current capacity.

faqs.question: Can I rent the ice cream bike without staff?
faqs.answer: Currently, we offer our ice cream bikes exclusively with our own trained service staff. This way, we guarantee that strict hygiene standards are maintained and that every guest receives a perfectly portioned scoop. In addition, our team takes care of the complete setup and dismantling, so you can relax.

faqs.question: Do you offer a tasting before booking for a wedding?
faqs.answer: Yes, for larger events and weddings, we are happy to invite you to a tasting. There you can try our current assortment and choose your favorite flavors at your leisure. Just ask us about this option when you inquire about a date.

faqs.question: What are the cancellation conditions if my event is cancelled?
faqs.answer: We know that plans can sometimes change unexpectedly. Therefore, we offer flexible cancellation periods, which we transparently break down in every offer. As a rule, free cancellation is easily possible up to a certain number of days before the event.

faqs.question: Is the ice cream bike also suitable for children's birthdays?
faqs.answer: An ice cream bike is the absolute highlight at every children's birthday party! On request, we bring extra colorful sprinkles, small surprises, and particularly child-friendly ice cream flavors. Thanks to its compact size, the little guests can pick up their ice cream at a comfortable height directly from the bike.

faqs.question: Can ice cream trucks and ice cream bikes be combined for mega-events?
faqs.answer: For very large events or festivals in Hanover, we are happy to offer a combination of several vehicles. While the classic ice cream truck serves as a central point of contact, the flexible ice cream bike can supply more remote areas of the site. This avoids long queues and all guests quickly get their sweet refreshment.

faqs.question: How does the ice cream bike get to my event location?
faqs.answer: We take care of the complete logistics for your party. The bike is safely transported to your location with a special transporter and unloaded by us on site. You don't have to worry about the bulky transport at all.

faqs.question: Does the ice cream bike absolutely need a power connection?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily, because our modern ice cream bikes have special, powerful cooling batteries. These keep the ice cream perfectly tempered for up to eight hours even without an active power connection. This makes us extremely independent, so we can also serve in the middle of a meadow in the park or by the Maschsee. However, if you book the bike for a longer period throughout the day, a 230-volt socket for occasional recharging is an advantage.

faqs.question: How much space does the ice cream bike take up?
faqs.answer: The bike is very compact and requires significantly less space than a classic ice cream truck. A level area of about two by two meters is completely sufficient for our staff to portion comfortably. In addition, the surface should be as firm as possible to ensure a secure stand when scooping.

faqs.question: Does the bike really fit through every normal room door?
faqs.answer: Our ice cream bike is designed to fit through all standard doors with a minimum width of 90 centimeters. Elevators are usually not a problem either, provided they have sufficient depth. Please briefly measure the exact passages at your location in advance to avoid unpleasant surprises on the day of the event.

faqs.question: How long does it take to set up the ice cream bike on site?
faqs.answer: Our team is extremely experienced and usually needs no more than 20 to 30 minutes for setup and preparation. We always arrive at the location in good time before the agreed start of service. This ensures that the first scoop of ice cream lands in the cup punctually at the agreed time.

faqs.question: Does the ice cream bike have its own lighting for evening events?
faqs.answer: Yes, our nostalgic ice cream bike can be equipped with atmospheric LED lighting. This creates a cozy atmosphere, especially in the late evening hours or at darkened indoor events. This way, the ice cream stand becomes the shining centerpiece of your party even after sunset.

faqs.question: Can the bike be ridden to the location independently?
faqs.answer: Although it is a functional bicycle, we do not cycle the distances to the event location. The weight of the structure and the cooling technology is enormous, which is why transport is always carried out with one of our vans for safety reasons. On site, we then push the bike the last few meters precisely to its destination.

faqs.question: How many ice cream flavors fit in the bike?
faqs.answer: Our compact, yet surprisingly spacious display case on the ice cream bike offers space for up to six different ice cream flavors at the same time. In practice, this is more than enough choice to cover all guests' taste preferences.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum purchase quantity when booking the ice cream bike?
faqs.answer: Yes, for the use of the ice cream bike at private or commercial parties, we charge a minimum purchase quantity, which is usually 100 scoops. For smaller events with fewer guests, this quantity is then simply billed as a basic flat rate. This way, your guests can easily get a second helping without your budget getting out of hand.

faqs.question: Can waffles and toppings also be served on the bike?
faqs.answer: Of course, when using the ice cream bike, we also bring our popular crispy waffles, ice cream cups, and various sauces. On a small shelf on the bike, we can also arrange colorful sprinkles and other treats.

faqs.question: Can I keep leftover ice cream after the event?
faqs.answer: For strict hygienic reasons and to maintain the cold chain, we take any remaining ice cream with us at the end of the serving time. However, our staff portions the quantities so skillfully that usually very little is left at the end. If you still have space in the freezer, we will gladly fill a few last cups for your freezer.

faqs.question: Is there special ice cream with alcohol for adult parties?
faqs.answer: For adult-only events, we can create unusual sorbets with a shot of alcohol upon request. Popular variations here include our sparkling Aperol Spritz ice cream or a refreshing Gin & Tonic sorbet. However, these special flavors must be explicitly requested when booking and are strictly only served to guests of legal age.

faqs.question: Can iced coffee or iced chocolate also be prepared on the bike?
faqs.answer: Since we lack the space for a professional coffee machine on the ice cream bike, we do not offer classic iced coffees as standard. However, we are happy to bring chilled filter coffee in small dispensers to conjure up a rustic "Cold Brew" variant with a delicious scoop of vanilla ice cream upon request.
